tools.name: read
tools.title: Read file
tools.summary: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to read, resolved by the filesystem backend.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 1-based first line to return. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

tools.name: write
tools.title: Write file
tools.summary: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

parameters.name: sandbox_permissions
parameters.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

parameters.name: justification
parameters.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

tools.name: edit
tools.title: Edit file
tools.summary: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to edit, resolved by the filesystem backend.

parameters.name: old_string
parameters.description: Literal text to replace.

parameters.name: new_string
parameters.description: Literal replacement text. Use an empty string to delete the match.

parameters.name: replace_all
parameters.description: Replace all matches. Defaults to false; when false, old_string must appear exactly once.

parameters.name: sandbox_permissions
parameters.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

parameters.name: justification
parameters.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.title: Working directory
tools.summary: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd.

parameters.name: cd
parameters.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: read_image
tools.title: Read image
tools.summary: Read a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF image and return the image itself.

parameters.name: file_path
parameters.description: Path to the image file, resolved by the filesystem backend.

tools.name: present
tools.title: Present files
tools.summary: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user.

parameters.name: files
parameters.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

tools.name: glob
tools.title: Glob files
tools.summary: Find files, not directories, whose paths match a glob pattern.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Glob pattern to match file paths against (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.test.js").

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Directory to search in. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path resolves against it.

tools.name: grep
tools.title: Grep contents
tools.summary: Search file contents with a ripgrep regular expression.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Regular expression to search for (ripgrep syntax).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the session workspace.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: One glob filter for which files to search (e.g. "*.ts", "*.{js,jsx}").

tools.name: pwsh
tools.title: PowerShell
tools.summary: Execute a PowerShell command (pwsh -Command) and return its stdout/stderr.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The PowerShell command to execute.

parameters.name: timeoutMs
parameters.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background.

parameters.name: workdir
parameters.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace.

parameters.name: run_in_background
parameters.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill).

parameters.name: sandbox_permissions
parameters.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

parameters.name: justification
parameters.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.title: Workspace dependencies
tools.summary: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and Node.js libraries, plus bundled distribution versions.

tools.name: subagent_fork
tools.title: Fork subagent
tools.summary: Delegate a task to a subagent that inherits this conversation's completed turns.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: The task for the subagent. It already sees this conversation's completed turns.

parameters.name: cwd
parameters.description: Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.title: List agents
tools.summary: List subagents you started, with their ids, labels, and status.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: children lists direct children; descendants lists the whole tree below you with parent session id and depth.

tools.name: interrupt_agent
tools.title: Interrupt agent
tools.summary: Ask a subagent to stop its current work. The call returns without waiting for it to stop.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The id of an agent created under you: your direct child or a deeper descendant.

tools.name: send_message
tools.title: Send message
tools.summary: Send a message to an agent. A working agent receives it at its next step; an idle agent starts a new turn.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The agent id of your direct continuable child, or your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to deliver to the agent.

tools.name: skill
tools.title: Load skill
tools.summary: Load the full instructions for a skill before acting on a task that matches it.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The exact skill name from the available skills list.

tools.name: workflow
tools.title: Run workflow
tools.summary: Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale, with phases and structured results.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: The plain JavaScript body; top-level await is allowed. End with a return of the result.

parameters.name: meta
parameters.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON: name, description, optional whenToUse and phases.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the args global.

parameters.name: run_in_background
parameters.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting.

tools.name: job_list
tools.title: List jobs
tools.summary: List your background jobs (running and finished) with their ids, kinds, and statuses.

tools.name: job_output
tools.title: Read job output
tools.summary: Read a background job: output since the previous read for stream jobs, or the result of a finished job.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the job finishes or the timeout expires; a timed-out wait leaves the job running.

parameters.name: timeout_ms
parameters.description: Max wait in milliseconds with wait: true. Defaults to and is capped by configuration.

tools.name: job_kill
tools.title: Kill job
tools.summary: Request cancellation of a running background job.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: Job id returned by the tool that started the background work.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional short reason, recorded in the log and forwarded to the job.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.title: Create goal
tools.summary: Create a persisted goal that keeps this session working across automatic continuation rounds.

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: The concrete completion objective inferred from the direct human request.

parameters.name: max_goal_rounds
parameters.description: Optional positive integer limit on automatic continuation rounds.

tools.name: get_goal
tools.title: Get goal
tools.summary: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.title: Update goal
tools.summary: Update the current goal: edit, pause, resume, complete, or mark it blocked.

parameters.name: goal_id
parameters.description: Exact id returned by get_goal.

parameters.name: revision
parameters.description: Exact positive revision returned by get_goal.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The lifecycle action to apply to the goal.

parameters.name: objective
parameters.description: Replacement objective; valid only with action edit.

parameters.name: max_goal_rounds
parameters.description: Replacement cap; valid only with action edit.

parameters.name: blocked_reason
parameters.description: Required only with action blocked: the concrete condition that persisted across rounds.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.title: Create reminder
tools.summary: Create a reminder in the current session that delivers a prompt when it becomes due.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Reminder content to present when the target becomes due.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Concise task name, at most 120 characters.

parameters.name: after_seconds
parameters.description: Delay in whole seconds.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

parameters.name: every_seconds
parameters.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: Every day at a local time: { time, time_zone }.

parameters.name: weekly
parameters.description: On the given weekdays at a local time: { time, time_zone, weekdays }.

parameters.name: cron
parameters.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone: { expression, time_zone }.

tools.name: schedule_update
tools.title: Update reminder
tools.summary: Change a reminder in place, keeping its id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Schedule id returned by schedule_list.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: New task name; follow the schedule_create title rules.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: New reminder content.

parameters.name: every_seconds
parameters.description: Fixed-rate interval in whole seconds, at least 60.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: Every day at a local time: { time, time_zone }.

parameters.name: weekly
parameters.description: On the given weekdays at a local time: { time, time_zone, weekdays }.

parameters.name: cron
parameters.description: Five-field Vixie cron expression in a time zone: { expression, time_zone }.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: Absolute target: an RFC 3339 date-time with offset, or a local date, time, and IANA time_zone.

tools.name: schedule_delete
tools.title: Delete reminder
tools.summary: Delete a reminder in the current session, active or inactive.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Exact schedule id.

tools.name: schedule_list
tools.title: List reminders
tools.summary: List the active reminders in the current session.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.title: Fetch URL
tools.summary: Fetch the content of a specific HTTP(S) URL and return it decoded to text.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The HTTP(S) URL to fetch.

tools.name: web_search
tools.title: Web search
tools.summary: Search the web for current information; returns an optional summary answer and source URLs.

parameters.name: queries
parameters.description: 1-4 search queries; their results are merged.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.title: Exit plan mode
tools.summary: Present your plan for the user's review and, on approval, leave plan mode.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description: The complete plan, as markdown, starting with a # heading that names it.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.title: Write todos
tools.summary: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress.

parameters.name: todos
parameters.description: The COMPLETE task list, replacing any previous list.

tools.name: ask_user_question
tools.title: Ask user
tools.summary: Ask the user a concise question when confirmation, a choice, or missing information is needed.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.description: Questions to ask the user before continuing.
